_avail.description: Stereo Pre-Amplifier, 2 stereo source zones, 4 stereo line inputs, 2 mic/line inputs, selective paging, emergency input, 0.5 Watts auto stdby, 2 U19" rack mounting, black
_avail.portsMissing: Not stated: mains inlet type (set to other) and whether each stereo zone output is one 3-pin Euroblock or one per side; the mute all contact is in the Emergency In notes; Wall Control uses signal type ebus (Biamp 2-wire wall panel bus)

ports.label: Emergency In
ports.notes: Balanced 0 dBV line level on Euroblock; triggered by VOX or potential-free contact on the mute all connection

ports.label: Paging Mic In
ports.notes: Mic or line on Euroblock; zone-selective paging with chime (MICPAT-2 / MICPAT-D)

ports.label: Mic A In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line on Euroblock; +48 V phantom switchable; VOX

ports.label: Mic A In (RCA)
ports.notes: Stereo line on RCA, mono summed

ports.label: Mic B In
ports.notes: Balanced mic or line on Euroblock; +48 V phantom switchable

ports.label: Mic B In (RCA)
ports.notes: Stereo line on RCA, mono summed

ports.label: Input 1
ports.notes: Stereo balanced line on Euroblock; summed with the Input 1 RCA

ports.label: Input 1 (RCA)
ports.notes: Stereo unbalanced line on RCA; summed with the Input 1 Euroblock

ports.label: Input 2
ports.notes: Stereo unbalanced line on RCA

ports.label: Input 3
ports.notes: Stereo unbalanced line on RCA

ports.label: Input 4
ports.notes: Stereo unbalanced line on RCA

ports.label: Zone 1 Out
ports.notes: Balanced stereo line output, 3-pin 0.3-inch Euroblock; mono/stereo switch; active together with the RCA output

ports.label: Zone 1 Out (RCA)
ports.notes: Unbalanced stereo line output on RCA; active together with the Euroblock output

ports.label: Zone 2 Out
ports.notes: Balanced stereo line output, 3-pin 0.3-inch Euroblock; mono/stereo switch; active together with the RCA output

ports.label: Zone 2 Out (RCA)
ports.notes: Unbalanced stereo line output on RCA; active together with the Euroblock output

ports.label: Ethernet
ports.notes: Control and configuration (web app, TCP), CAT5e or better

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: 3-pin Euroblock, 115200 8-N-1

ports.label: Priority Out
ports.notes: 3-pin Euroblock with two 24 V DC priority signals (one per zone), active on emergency or paging

ports.label: Wall Control 1
ports.notes: 2-pin Euroblock to one DIWAC / D-DIWAC wall panel for zone 1; data and power on two wires, no polarity; up to 500 m; DIWAC 2-wire bus (data and power)

ports.label: Wall Control 2
ports.notes: 2-pin Euroblock to one DIWAC / D-DIWAC wall panel for zone 2; data and power on two wires, no polarity; up to 500 m; DIWAC 2-wire bus (data and power)

ports.label: AC Power
ports.notes: 100-240 V AC 3-prong mains power cord connection with switch and fuse (T1AL/250V); inlet type not stated
